summary: HDFC Bank Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, disclosing the outcome of its Board meeting held July 18, 2026. The Board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, including net profit of INR 19,059.72 crore, basic EPS of INR 12.38, and capital adequacy ratio of 19.57%. No special-situation transaction is announced; the filing is a routine periodic earnings report. The trading window will open July 21, 2026.
